```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "The diode-connected PMOS load has Vsg near Vth_p (about 1.0-1.3 V at slow corners), which pins Vout near 0.32 V and caps swing. Replacing it with an NMOS load (gate and drain at VDD, bulk tied to source to remove body effect) lowers the load threshold and widens the range to about VDD - Vth_n - Vdsat. Tying the NMOS bulk to its source is a deliberate exception to the vss-bulk rule."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (15.0, 9.0, 18.0),           # signal nFET gm/Id [S/A] (high gm/Id -> lower Vdsat)
    "L_n": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),                # signal nFET length [um]
    "gmid_L": (11.0, 6.0, 14.0),           # NMOS load gm/Id [S/A]
    "L_L": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),                # NMOS load length [um]
    "I": (0.4e-3, 0.15e-3, 1.0e-3),        # branch current [A]
}

VDD_NOM, VDD_MIN, VDD_MAX = 1.8, 1.62, 1.98
CORNERS = [("tt", 27), ("ss", 125), ("ss", -40), ("ff", -40),
           ("ff", 125), ("sf", 27), ("fs", 27)]


def _solve_load(dev_lut, W, Lp, I_target, vmax):
    """Bisection on x = Vgs = Vds of the NMOS load (gate and drain at VDD, source at vout)."""
    lo, hi = 0.05, vmax - 0.05
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        Id = dev_lut.op("n", W, Lp, mid, vds=mid)["Id"]
        if Id > I_target:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)


def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    vcm = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 20e-6)
    I = p["I"]

    # Sizing from intent (gm/Id, L, current)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I, vds=0.6)   # signal CS device
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_L"], p["L_L"], I, vds=1.0)   # NMOS load, Vds ~ 1 V
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)            # reference sink (DC path for ibias)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)            # common-source amplifier
    # NMOS load: drain and gate at vdd, source at vout; bulk tied to source (no body effect)
    n.dev("M2", "vdd", "vdd", "vout", "vout", m2)
    n.dev("Mb", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)         # sinks iref; no signal path

    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd

    # Corner / supply sweep. The load is always saturated while on (Vds = Vgs), so
    # Vout = VDD - x, where x solves I_load(x) = I_M1(vout).
    gain_wc, f3db_wc, gbw_wc = 1e9, 1e9, 1e9
    vout_lo = 1e9
    head_wc, range_wc = 1e9, 1e9

    for corner, temp in CORNERS:
        L_ = lut.at(corner, temp)
        for vdd_c in (VDD_MIN, VDD_MAX):
            vout = 0.7
            x = 0.9
            for _ in range(3):                                  # fixed-point on vout
                a_it = L_.op("n", m1.W, p["L_n"], vcm, vds=max(vout, 0.05))
                x = _solve_load(L_, m2.W, p["L_L"], a_it["Id"], vdd_c)
                vout = vdd_c - x
            a = L_.op("n", m1.W, p["L_n"], vcm, vds=vout)
            b = L_.op("n", m2.W, p["L_L"], x, vds=x)

            gtot_c = b["gm"] + b["gds"] + a["gds"]
            gain_c = a["gm"] / gtot_c
            f_c = gtot_c / (2 * PI * cout)
            gbw_c = a["gm"] / (2 * PI * cout)

            gain_wc = min(gain_wc, gain_c)
            f3db_wc = min(f3db_wc, f_c)
            gbw_wc = min(gbw_wc, gbw_c)
            vout_lo = min(vout_lo, vout)
            head_wc = min(head_wc, vout - a["vdsat"])
            # Swing range: from M1 triode edge up to load cutoff (Vgs_L = Vth_L)
            range_wc = min(range_wc, (vdd_c - b["vth"]) - a["vdsat"])

    swing = min(2 * gain_wc * 0.3, range_wc)
    power_mw = 1e3 * VDD_MAX * (I + iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain_wc),
        "f3db": f3db_wc / 1e6,      # MHz
        "gbw": gbw_wc / 1e6,        # MHz
        "power": power_mw,          # mW
        "vout_dc": vout_lo,         # V, worst (lowest) DC level over supply and corners
        "swing": swing,             # V
        "headroom_n": head_wc,      # V, worst-corner Vout - Vdsat(M1)
    }
```
